description: ASNs whose address space is used for anonymizer egress (VPN, WARP, proxy networks). A node whose verified egress IP is in one of these ASNs is classed 'masked'. Hand-maintained from each operator's own published ASN (PeeringDB / bgp.he.net / RIR whois). Facts only (ASN numbers and operator names); no third-party database is copied. Extend at deploy time with ANONYMIZER_ASNS="1,2,3". Shared hosting ASNs that many VPNs rent from (M247, Datacamp/CDN77, Leaseweb, ...) stay 'dc' via HOSTING_ASNS: dc is already the lower-trust class, and IP-level lists (data/anonymizer-ips.txt) catch known exits inside them.

asns.name: Cloudflare, Inc. (WARP / Zero Trust shared egress)
asns.note: AS13335 is all of Cloudflare, but Cloudflare sells no general hosting with customer-controlled egress, so a node egress IP in it is in practice WARP/Zero Trust. Cloudflare does not publish WARP egress ranges, so the ASN cannot be narrowed.
